text:
Marta Gomez: Quick copy check for the rollback modal — when a rollout cannot be rolled back because there are active sessions pinned to the new version. Current text reads bluntly: "Rollback blocked: active sessions present." Can we make it clearer and provide next steps?
Jin: Saw this in QA. Needs to explain why and what to do next (short). Also avoid sounding like a hard error.
Rae: Agree. UX goal: neutral tone, one clear action (drain sessions / wait), and an optional explain line. On small screens we need one short headline + a compact CTA.
Liam (eng): Implementation: we show the modal to org admins only; we already have a drain-sessions endpoint. The modal CTA can trigger the drain action or open the sessions page. If we call drain we should show a confirmation microcopy.
Marta Gomez: Draft options for headline (very short):
- "Rollback paused — active sessions
- "Rollback blocked: active sessions present
- "Cannot roll back while sessions are active"
Rae: Prefer the verb-first action in the CTA. Examples for the primary button: "Drain sessions" or "Open sessions". Keep action label <= 3 words.
Jin: Wording suggestions (headline + subtext + CTA):
```
Headline: "Rollback paused — active sessions"
Subtext: "Some user sessions are still using the new version. Drain sessions or open the sessions page to proceed."
Primary CTA: "Drain sessions"
Secondary CTA: "Open sessions"
```
Rae: Subtext is a bit long. Trim for mobile: "Some sessions use the new version. Drain them or view sessions."
Marta Gomez: Good point. Also accessibility: announce the modal with role=alertdialog and ensure the subtext is readable by screen readers. Use full words in code strings for i18n (avoid contractions).
Liam (eng): I'll wire aria-labels and ensure the confirmation after "Drain sessions" says: "Sessions are being drained. Rollback will continue once sessions end." That should be concise.
Jin: For tone, avoid words like "blocked" if we want softer feel. "Paused" or "On hold" read better.
Marta Gomez: Final mock strings for handoff:
```
Headline: "Rollback paused — active sessions"
Subtext (short): "Some user sessions are using the new version. Drain sessions or view sessions to continue."
Primary CTA: "Drain sessions"
Secondary CTA: "View sessions"
Confirmation after action: "Draining sessions. Rollback will proceed after sessions end."
Code strings (no contractions):
Headline: "Rollback paused - active sessions"
Subtext: "Some user sessions are using the new version. Drain sessions or view sessions to continue."
Primary CTA: "Drain sessions"
Secondary CTA: "View sessions"
Confirmation: "Draining sessions. Rollback will proceed after sessions end."
```
Rae: LGTM. Tiny nit: test truncation on very small widths for "Rollback paused - active sessions". If it wraps poorly, we can shorten headline to just "Rollback paused" and rely on subtext.
Liam (eng): I'll test wrapping and confirm aria announcements tomorrow. If we need a shorter headline I'll suggest "Rollback paused".
NotifyBot: Reminder scheduled: prod copy freeze review in 48 hours.
Marta Gomez: Thanks everyone — I'll update the Figma artboard and ping when done :sparkles:
